response.sql: SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(l.DNA) AS average_anti_DNA, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS average_albumin_minus_total_protein FROM Laboratory AS l INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY p.SEX;

assumptions.assumption: The blank sex value forms its own group, as SQL groups NULL values together; missing DNA or ALB/TP inputs are ignored by AVG, and an average with no nonmissing inputs is NULL.
